files_authored.description: Case YAML and alteration T-SQL paths written.

root_coverage.description: One entry per root in the plan comment.

kind.description: primary_positive is expected to differ toward the authoritative value; guardrail is expected to stay flat.

coverage_gaps.description: Roots left uncovered, one entry each. A gap reported is a finding; a gap hidden is a defect.

reason.description: Why: no eligible fixture, unreachable for this merchant, needs data the snapshot lacks, plan comment listed no roots.

fixtures.description: Merchants/URL IDs/locations/certificates used, and the eligibility checks each satisfies.

alteration_used.description: Whether an alteration applies fixture data to BOTH arms.

offline_validation_passed.description: Whether the loader/plan dry run parsed every case.

pushed.description: Whether the cases are pushed to the PR branch.

head_sha.description: Head SHA after the push — the plan must correspond to this SHA.

run_label_added.description: False unless the audit stage explicitly asked this session to label. The audit stage owns firing ratevariant:run and interpreting the result; labeling on its request is mechanics, but the session that wrote the cases never grades them.

suspected_dead_branches.description: Code paths no case can reach, with why — the audit stage needs these to read a no-diff correctly.
